name: spellkave_stage_scene
label: Stage scene
description: Explicitly stage an unmodified connected scene preview as the same caller in the expected world instance. Existing apply admission guards graph expansion and population; each phase reports committed, refused or unknown. Never retries an unknown result, resets a reused name or grants controller/deletion authority. Inspect the world before recovery; graph Despawn ejects occupants and leaves cleanup residuals.

plan.description: Unmodified plan from a connected render_scene preview.

limitations: Complete Internal source read and destination write authority required; cleanup coverage remains unknown.
argumentGates: Strict graph-only source guard and every phase world-instance guard recheck on the server.
